<thought>The mass spectrum shows a base peak at m/z 100.0524. Assuming this is the molecular ion (M⁺), the neutral mass is 100.0524 Da. The exact mass of C₅H₈O₂ is 100.052425 Da, matching the observed value within sub‑ppm error and giving an integer DBE (2). Therefore the molecular formula is C5H8O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C5H8O2</final_answer>
